qualification: Empty exact-commit query responses mean no known OSV findings at query time; they are not proof of safety. SQLCipher 4.19.0 is the upstream remediation for two issues disclosed 2026-09-08 affecting 4.18.0 and earlier.

issues.conditions: Attacker-controlled attached database aliases must reach sqlcipher_export through SQL injection or unrestricted SQL access.
issues.effect: Aliases can alter generated SQL statements; upstream says encryption and per-page integrity remain intact and this issue does not leak data.
issues.name: Unquoted schema aliases in sqlcipher_export

issues.conditions: A new database is opened with the optional hexkey URI parameter containing no valid key material.
issues.effect: Affected versions can create a plaintext SQLite database without reporting an error; 4.19.0 reports an error.
issues.name: Invalid nonempty URI hexkey

vendorAdvisories.qualification: Upstream rates both issues Low. The export issue and plaintext-creation issue have different effects. These vendor findings invalidate an unqualified security clearance for 4.18.0 even when its OSV response is empty; the 4.19.0 candidate still requires signature, build, runtime, and independent acceptance checks.
